entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I found myself with some free time, so[n]I was hoping to find someone to play[n]against.
You always seem so busy.[clr 27]
Do you have no friends?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, I wouldn't say I'm unoccupied,[n]but I'm not busy all the time either.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If anything, it's my policy to spend my[n]spare time in meaningful ways.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: As in, people I'd actively choose to see[n]in my free time?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If that's what you mean, then no,[n]I suppose I don't have many.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Now, let's play a game. You've played[n]pool before, correct?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, my apologies. A break ace.
Is that your win?
Not bad.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, the 9-ball's been sunk already,[n]so...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But that was just a coincidence, of course,[n]so we can start over. That won't count.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It was just a coincidence.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Of course, this game won't count.[n]Let's start over.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oof... Bad move on my part. If you get[n]this next one, I'm in trouble.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Not bad. Everything's riding on your next[n]shot, though. How will you handle this?
Shoot very carefully.[clr 27]
I'll go for a power shot.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, let's see your skills.
There wasn't enough force.[n]It didn't even reach the pocket...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, let's see your skills.
I used too much force.[n]It bounced off the cushions...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I win.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That was a close one, though. I suppose[n]it would have been embarrassing to lose[n]as your senior, huh?
Something seems off...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Thank you, that's great news. I sense[n]something in you that's quite different[n]from other people.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I guess you can call it my detective's[n]intuition? Haha, kidding, of course.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, my apologies. A break ace.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Is something the matter?
You used your right hand.
...Aren't you left-handed?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Huh...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm honestly impressed you noticed.[n]That's right, this one's my dominant[n]hand.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I switched hands during the game. It's[n]not anything against you. Going all-out[n]against a junior just seems a bit gauche...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But I confess you've surprised me.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm rather dextrous with my right hand.[n]I can even use chopsticks with it. Frankly,[n]I didn't expect you to see through it.
Maybe I'll be a detective.
No holding back next time.
I see a lot of things.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: A fine idea. My job would be a bit more[n]exciting if I had a rival.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Interesting. It's a nice idea... I'd like to[n]try a match where I don't have to hold[n]anything back.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, so those glasses are just for the[n]aesthetic, then?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Or were you being metaphorical? You're[n]a hard one to read sometimes.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: In any case, you truly are interesting.[n]You never cease to intrigue me.
I can sense Akechi's[n]appreciation...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If you ever manage to win against me[n]using my right hand, then I will face you[n]with everything I have.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You have my word.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, see you.
